第一卷第19章 父仇得报波澜再起（第1页）
这些家族私下里再如何闹，如何争斗，他是根本懒得管的，甚至有时候还会偷偷推波助澜一把。
当着他的面，还是在大齐武院资格战这种重要时刻。
他这个天武城主的脸面，可就丢得一干二净了。
顾寒和顾长早就红了眼，恨不得将对方杀之而后快，又哪里会听他的话？
柳渊眼中寒光乍现，身上气势瞬间攀升起来，聚元三重境的修为暴露无遗！
他瞬间来到即将撞在一起的二人身旁，体内灵力尽数爆发，震开了二人！
“老夫最后悔的一件事，就是当日没将你亲手宰了！”
剑尖上聚起一道三寸剑芒，就要再次朝顾长冲过去！
双方修为差距颇大，顾寒此前又受了不轻的伤，自然有些抵挡不住。
顾长也稍稍恢复了几分理智，连忙向柳渊行礼。
“今日之后，我亲自去城主府请罪，任由城主发落，绝不敢有半句怨言！”
各家家主面色一变，暗骂顾长的狡猾。
顾家在天武城再无立足之地，肯定会遭到所有人的抵制，这偌大的家业必然保不住，还不如拿出大部分好处，彻底投靠柳渊。
各家再想动顾家，就得掂量掂量了。
柳渊自然明白他的意思，语气缓和了些。
“来之前，这副烂摊子要处理好！”
顾长松了口气，看了一眼顾成的头颅和被彻底废掉的顾阳，恨得咬牙切齿。

众人看着低头不语的顾寒，暗暗叹了口气。
跟他们相反，那些顾家人，却是一脸劫后余生的表情，心里暗暗称赞顾长的足智多谋。
此刻，也只有她最能理解顾寒的心情了。
有城主在，这仇你还能报？你拿什么报？
顾长心里一喜，趁势道：“此子桀骜不驯，根本不将您放在眼里，若是留着他，必是一个祸……”
那道光太快，快到就算以柳渊的修为，也来不及拦截！
以大衍剑气的速度，擂台只有十丈范围，自然是瞬息即至，顾长又哪里躲得开？
七皇子看到这一剑，激动得面色通红，直接站了起来。
“薛老不是说了，您的情绪不要有太大的起落吗，唉……您怎么就不听呢？”
“呈一时之能，就是个莽夫罢了！”

> Volume 1, Chapter 19: Father's revenge is avenged and the waves rise again (Page 1)
Volume 1, Chapter 19: Father's revenge is avenged and the waves rise again (Page 1)
No matter how these families quarrel or fight in private, he doesn't bother to care at all, and sometimes even secretly adds fuel to the flames.
In front of him, it was still at such an important moment as the Daqi Martial Arts Academy Qualification Battle.
The face of him, the Lord of Tianwu City, was completely lost.
Gu Han and Gu Chang had already become red-eyed and wanted to kill each other quickly, so how could they listen to him?
A cold light suddenly appeared in Liu Yuan's eyes, and his aura instantly rose. His cultivation in the third level of Juyuan was fully exposed!
He instantly came to the side of the two people who were about to collide, and all the spiritual power in his body exploded, shocking the two people away!
"The thing I regret most is that I didn't kill you with my own hands that day!"
A three-inch sword light gathered on the tip of the sword, and he was about to rush towards Gu Chang again!
There was a big gap in cultivation between the two sides. Gu Han had suffered a serious injury before, so naturally he couldn't resist.
Chief Gu also regained some sense and quickly saluted Liu Yuan.
"After today, I will personally go to the City Lord's Mansion to plead guilty. I will let the City Lord do whatever he wants and I will never dare to complain!"
The faces of the heads of each family changed, and they secretly cursed Chief Gu for his cunning.
The Gu family no longer has a foothold in Tianwu City and will definitely be resisted by everyone. Such a huge family fortune will inevitably be unable to be saved. It is better to use most of the benefits and completely surrender to Liu Yuan.
If any family wants to touch the Gu family, they have to think carefully.
Liu Yuan naturally understood what he meant and softened his tone.
"Before we come here, this mess needs to be sorted out!"
Gu Chang breathed a sigh of relief, glanced at Gu Cheng's head and the completely crippled Gu Yang, and gritted his teeth with hatred.
Everyone looked at Gu Han who lowered his head and said nothing, and sighed secretly.
Contrary to them, those Gu family members looked like they were surviving a disaster, and they secretly praised Chief Gu for his resourcefulness.
At this moment, she was the only one who could understand Gu Han's mood best.
With the city lord here, can you still avenge this? What do you pay for?
Chief Gu was overjoyed and took advantage of the situation and said: "This boy is unruly and doesn't take you seriously at all. If you keep him, it will be a disaster..."
That light was so fast that even with Liu Yuan's cultivation, there was no time to intercept it!
With the speed of Dayan Sword Qi, the arena is only within ten feet. Naturally, it is coming in an instant. How can Chief Gu avoid it?
When the seventh prince saw this sword, his face turned red with excitement and he stood up directly.
"Didn't Mr. Xue tell you not to have too many emotional ups and downs? Alas... why didn't you listen?"
"You're just a reckless man if you show off your talents for the moment!"
